Leakages in domes of Jama Masjid,
Delhi
*41. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there are multiple leakages in the domes of
the 17th century old mosque Jama Masjid,

assessment of damage caused due to

Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND

state:

 SHRI B.J. PANDA:

Palace on Wheels from Orissa;

for inflation in India; and

Restoration of old havelis in
Chandni Chowk, Delhi
*53. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
restore the old havelis in Chandni Chowk
and nearby areas of Old Delhi, some of
which are also historically important and

sector

oustees

oustees have not been done;

have been established in Tamil Nadu for
automobile users alongwith details in each
town in Tamil Nadu;
(c) the proposals to meet the growing
demands; and
